Name: Three Crops
Author: MoreMusic
Description:
This might be a mod for you if you want to add a few more crops to the game. If your using say [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]PPJA - Fruits and Veggies[/url] I'm not sure how well this mod will work with that one.

Plant the jalapeño seeds in spring or summer. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest. If left long enough, it will turn red. (not in game)

Plant the raspberry seeds in summer. Takes 8 days to mature, and keeps producing raspberries after that. A small, deep colored berry which has a tender texture.

Plant the spinach seeds in the fall. Takes 6 days to mature. It's an extremely nutrient-rich vegetable.

This mod is balanced nicely with the base game in terms of pricing, energy, health and gifting. Maybe Shane might love a jalapeño or maybe you need to restore energy, spinach might be the way to go. 

You will find all the seeds at Pierre's in the respected seasons.
